name: Akito Kamei
bio: Akito’s research focuses on development economics, with particular interests in human capital investment, including health, sanitation, water, child, and education in low- and middle-income countries. His work combines rigorous empirical methods, including RCTs and large-scale administrative and survey data. He has worked with international organizations including UNICEF, the World Bank, and the Inter-American Development Bank, and served as a Postdoctoral Scholar at the Development Innovation Lab (DIL) at the University of Chicago.
